nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template for environment variables covering server port, PostgreSQL connection settings, and JWT authentication secrets used by the backend.

nodes.name: .prettierrc.json
nodes.summary: Prettier formatting configuration enforcing single quotes and trailing commas across the monorepo.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Mandatory agent instructions for working in the Rolliúde Play repository, pointing to project standards and ADRs and listing hard rules such as no `any`, no comments in touched files, and no duplicate sources of truth.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview describing the stack, requirements, how to run the app via Docker or manually, available checks, and canonical sources of truth for standards.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose orchestration defining services (likely backend, frontend, and database) and a shared volume for local development of Rolliúde Play.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a top-level services block alongside a volumes block, typical of a multi-container local dev setup coordinating backend, frontend, and database images.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root package manifest declaring the project name, scripts, and dependencies/devDependencies for the monorepo.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript compiler configuration with compilerOptions and an include list controlling which files are type-checked.

nodes.name: usuarios
nodes.summary: SQL definition of the usuarios (users) table with id, nome, email, senha_hash, tipo, and criado_em columns backing authentication and user records.
